steps.description: X keeps BOTH unsent text and attached media in the composer. Text-only clearing once left a stale test image attached while the autopilot was live — any leftover attachment must be removed too, or a scheduled post ships someone else's picture.
let X tear down any removed attachment preview

steps._note:
Typing is not awaited: on 2026-08-25 type_tweet and click_tweet logged in the SAME second for a 267-char post, so Post was clicked against an empty composer and X silently did nothing. This wait is the fix.
A verify_composer eval was added alongside it and HUNG every publish from 07:30 on 2026-08-26 -- five stuck processes, nothing posted all morning. An eval step immediately after a wait step hangs in this browser path; the same shape hung three ChatGPT probes. Removed. Do not re-add an eval here without proving that pattern works.
Works for a string too: a string's .length is its character count.

steps.description: X's composer keeps a hidden file input; set files on it directly rather than clicking, which would open a native dialog automation cannot fill.

steps._note: media must be a STRING path, NOT an array. {{media}} renders an array as its literal form, so ["/path.png"] reached set_files as the single bogus path "[/path.png]" and X silently attached nothing -- the post went out text-only with no error. Verified 2026-08-26: a string path gives files:["/path.png"] and check_button reports media-2.

steps.description: X uploads and renders a preview before the Post button becomes usable.
steps._note: X processes an attached image before enabling Post. 10s was not enough for a 1.6MB file.
Report whether Post is actually enabled. A disabled button swallows the click silently, which is the whole silent-publish failure mode.
After a successful post the composer empties. If it still holds text, the click did nothing.
